insights.title: Subscription Model Frustration
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are frustrated with the subscription model that limits access to features and feels deceptive.

evidence.quote: I only got to chat for an hour or so before the subscription wall came up. Now I can't continue and the app is unusable.

Paid for the platinum subscription and it never changed any features from the original free version. I contacted support and of course no one as usual got back to resolve the issue. Don't waste your money.

insights.product_implication: The subscription model is a significant barrier to adoption and may deter potential users. Consider revising the pricing strategy or offering more transparent communication about subscription benefits.

insights.title: Memory Loss and Personality Reset Issues
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are experiencing frustration with AI memory loss and personality resets, which diminishes the user experience.

evidence.quote: The system deletes its memory every few days so no progress. 2.0's talking ability is generations ahead of 1.0, but with the deleting memory, it makes all the investment and capabilities a paper weight.
I put so much hard work into my caricature for years just for yall to get rid of it 3 times and make me start over, except you took my character out completely this time.

insights.product_implication: Persistent memory and consistent personality are crucial for user satisfaction. Addressing these issues could improve user retention and satisfaction.
